title: savings-ledger — one row per request (draft v0)
description: DIRECTION.md §4.3 + §8.4 measurement honesty: the free count_tokens probe on the original body vs actually-billed usage, in the same row. Simultaneously the billing basis (Team), the upsell proof (Free→Pro), and the trust artifact (Enterprise).

counterfactual_input_tokens.description: count_tokens probe on the ORIGINAL (uncurated) request body — the only permitted baseline (§8.4). null = probe failed; never estimated.

billed_input_tokens.description: Actually-billed uncached input tokens from the upstream usage block.

cachePrefixSha8.description: Cache-bust attribution (§4.3, adopted from pxpipe): hash of the served conversation prefix.

fail_open.description: True when this request was served passthrough after an error (§8.3).

conv_id.description: Proxy conversation identity (hash-derived; no raw content).
